**Finding: compliant** (GOVLAW — governing law and venue)

- **§ 28.1** — New York law, conflict-of-law rules excluded, CISG disclaimed.
- **§ 28.2** — exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, with a mutual carve-out for temporary injunctive relief.
- No arbitration provision exists in the document, so there is no foreign-seated arbitration risk.

This matches the preferred position exactly (New York law + exclusive New York County courts); no redline proposed. The mutual executive-escalation step in § 28.3 is noted only — it is reciprocal, carves out urgent relief and limitations-period filings, and does not displace the agreed forum.
